The '''year 53,300 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Around that year, the [[Quake]], a series of intense [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that lasted for centuries, ended on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]].
